A mid-sized test project with 30-50 tasks across 10 files, demonstrating dependencies and labels.

## Structure

- `backend/` - Backend development tasks
  - `backend/api.md` - API implementation
  - `backend/database.md` - Database work

- `frontend/` - Frontend development tasks

  - `frontend/state.md` - State management
  - `frontend/tests.md` - Frontend testing
- `docs/` - Documentation tasks
  - `docs/api-docs.md` - API documentation
  - `docs/user-guide.md` - User documentation
